channel.title: Capricorn's Encyclopedia Updates
channel.description: Recent additions and modifications to the encyclopedia entries and features.

item.title: Features: Visual Redesign, Links in Summaries
item.description: The visual look of the worldbuilding page has been revamped. The map covers the whole screen and information pops up in a sidebar. You can switch between entries by clicking on links found in the summaries. Links to nonexistent articles show up as red. Happy Halloween!

item.title: Feature: View On Map
item.description: Added a way to find an entry on the map. When you open an entry to the selection tab, click "View on map" and the map pans to its location.

item.title: Experimental: Galactic Regions
item.description: Started planning out of Galactic Regions. Mainly to make it easier to define some locations for places. Also added settings to show/hide features on the map.
